'''Salis D'aar Spaceport''' was the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. It was located in [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and overseen by the [[Salis D'aar Spaceport Authority]]. During the [[Bakura Incident]], [[Pad 12]] was given over to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] for their use.
